name: Node-RADS
definition: Final recorded Node-RADS 1.0 grade, entered as a numeric ordinal value from 1 to 5

name: Noncontrast attenuation
definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal CT attenuation

name: Contrast-enhanced attenuation
definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal CT attenuation

name: Noncontrast iodine concentration
definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal iodine concentration

name: Contrast-enhanced iodine concentration
definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal iodine concentration

name: Noncontrast effective atomic number
definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal effective atomic number

name: Contrast-enhanced effective atomic number
definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal effective atomic number

name: Noncontrast electron density
definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal electron density as a percentage of water electron density

name: Contrast-enhanced electron density
definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal electron density as a percentage of water electron density

name: 70-keV attenuation
definition: Recorded nodal attenuation in the 70-keV reconstruction

name: 100-keV attenuation
definition: Recorded nodal attenuation in the 100-keV reconstruction

name: Calcium-suppression setting 30
definition: Recorded nodal attenuation at manufacturer calcium-suppression setting 30; the setting is not a photon energy

name: Calcium-suppression setting 70
definition: Recorded nodal attenuation at manufacturer calcium-suppression setting 70; the setting is not a photon energy

name: Short-axis diameter
definition: Maximal axial short-axis diameter; primary eligibility requires >3 mm

name: Long-axis diameter
definition: Recorded axial long-axis diameter

name: Attenuation increment
definition: ce_ct - nc_ct

name: Iodine increment
definition: ce_iodine - nc_iodine

name: 70-to-100-keV attenuation slope
definition: (ct_70kev - ct_100kev) / 30

name: Calcium-suppression difference
definition: casupp_70 - casupp_30

name: Arterial reference attenuation
definition: Contrast-enhanced CT attenuation in the common carotid artery at the same level

name: Muscle reference attenuation
definition: Contrast-enhanced CT attenuation in erector spinae muscle at the same level

name: Nodal-to-arterial attenuation ratio
definition: ce_ct / ce_ct_artery; a zero denominator produces missing

name: Nodal-to-muscle attenuation ratio
definition: ce_ct / ce_ct_muscle; a zero denominator produces missing
